title: entitopia project configuration
description: The project file execute_project.py loads: which steps exist, and which phases each runs.

steps.description: Run in declared order. A step's name is also its configuration subdirectory.

phases.description: Closed on purpose. An unrecognized phase name reaches the dispatcher's else branch, logs an error, and lets the run continue having silently skipped that work — so a typo here costs a whole phase with a green-looking run.

all_phases.description: Documentation of the phases this project may use. Not enforced against steps: it records intent, and a step naming a phase absent from here is legal.

logLevel.description: Passed to logger.setLevel. An unrecognized value is caught by AttributeError at startup and warned about, leaving the default level in place.
